oct31:
So much has happened today. 
Feels like this is all a 
big dream.

I woke up in a strange forest,
with a weird looking sky. 
Some of my things were laying 
around, but this journal was 
nowhere to be found.
The place is filled with wild 
monsters that attack me on 
sight, but I was able to 
defend myself using my Aura 
magic.
[page]
In that forest I found an 
adorable little water spirit, 
which I named {{alcine}}. 
They really helped me with 
their healing magic, It's 
really something I should 
learn to do myself.

Together we explored a ruined 
city. From there I got a good
view of this place, with it's 
grid patters in the distance.

It must be so far from my 
home.
[page]
This is a little map I drew, 
and {{alcine}} doodled on it.

[diary_doodle]AmberelmMap.png[/img]
Unfortunatly I do not know
where {{alcine}} is now.
In that ruined city, out
of nowhere, a giant rock
monster attacked us.

It was horrifying, and
stronger than anything we
we could handle.

But then at the last moment,
a human saved me and cut 
that thing in half like it 
was nothing!
[page]
As I'm writing this, I'm sitting 
in a camp Daze (the human)
set up.

Somehow, he found this 
journal, but a lot of the pages
are mysteriously missing.

A missing page for every 
missing memory...
oct31_dazesus:
[page]
Daze took care of my wounds
and everything, so I am
thankful, but I'm still not sure
what it is he wants...

He brushed off a lot of things
I wanted to ask him.
